title: Positive and Negative Numbers
topic: Representing quantities with positive and negative numbers; the number line

items.prompt: A temperature of 10 degrees below zero is best represented as:
items.rationale: "Below zero" is represented with a negative number.

items.prompt: On a number line, -7 is located:

choices.D: Cannot be placed on a number line

items.rationale: Negative numbers are located to the left of 0.

items.prompt: A debt of $50 can be represented as:
items.rationale: Owing money is represented with a negative number relative to zero balance.

items.prompt: Which is greater: -3 or -8? Write the greater number.
items.rationale: -3 is closer to zero (further right on the number line), so -3 > -8.
A number and its opposite are the same distance from 0 but on opposite sides.
